caption: The drawing depicts a single, round bowl positioned centrally within a rectangular border. The bowl is predominantly a deep red color, with variations in shading to suggest reflections and depth, including lighter and darker red areas inside and outside the bowl. The bowl sits on a small, short circular base that is gray with dark and light highlights to represent its metallic or reflective surface. The background is a plain, light beige color with minimal marks and a few faint spots rather than any additional scenery or objects. The entire composition is framed by a thin, gray line close to the edges of the paper.
title: Ruby Bowl with Clear Foot
